name: KY-015 temperature and humidity sensor (DHT11)
not_buildable: The sensor sends its readings as a coded data stream. It needs an extra Arduino library, and LearnLens only compiles sketches with its two approved libraries.
identification: Small black PCB with 3 angled header pins at one end and a light blue plastic box with a grid of holes covering most of the board.

facts.statement: The DHT11 reports temperature (0 to 50 C) and humidity digitally, with a new reading about every 2 seconds. The vendor's example uses the Adafruit DHT sensor libraries.
facts.source: Joy-IT SensorKit, KY-015, technical data and code example
